rules.title: Berkeley 2026 Annual General Adjustment (AGA) of 1.0%
rules.requirement: The Berkeley Rent Stabilization Board adopted the 2026 Annual General Adjustment Order (Regulation 1148). Eligible landlords may raise the 2025 permanent rent ceilings by 1.0% no earlier than January 1, 2026. The AGA is set at 65% of the Bay Area CPI-U increase (1.5%) for July 1, 2024 to June 30, 2025. The AGA may not adjust rents for tenancies that began on or after January 1, 2025 whose rents were set under Costa-Hawkins. The Order sets the conditions for qualifying and the notice required to tenants.
rules.key_value: 2026 AGA 1.0% (65% of 1.5% CPI increase); no increase before Jan 1, 2026

coverage.summary: Applies to rent-stabilized units in Berkeley with permanent rent ceilings. It does not adjust rents for tenancies beginning on or after Jan 1, 2025 whose rents were set under Costa-Hawkins.
coverage.other_conditions: Landlord must qualify under Regulation 1148 conditions and give the required notice to tenants. Not applicable to tenancies beginning on or after 1/1/2025 with Costa-Hawkins rents.

rules.exemptions: Tenancies that began on or after January 1, 2025 and had rents set under the Costa-Hawkins Rental Housing Act are not adjusted by the 2026 AGA.
rules.effective_date_note: Increase may be taken no earlier than January 1, 2026. The Executive Director's notice is dated October 17, 2025.
citation_aliases: Berkeley Rent Stabilization Board AGA Order for Year 2026
rules.quoted_span:
adopted the Annual General Adjustment (AGA) Order for Year 2026 which will allow 
eligible landlords to increase the 2025 permanent rent ceilings by 1.0% no earlier than 
January 1, 2026.
rules.review_note: Full conditions and notice requirements are in Regulation 1148, which is not reproduced in this notice.

result.doc_summary: Official Berkeley Rent Stabilization Board public notice (Oct. 17, 2025) announcing the 2026 Annual General Adjustment of 1.0%, which is 65% of the 1.5% Bay Area CPI increase. It can be taken no earlier than Jan 1, 2026, and does not adjust rents for tenancies beginning on or after Jan 1, 2025 with Costa-Hawkins rents. It cites Reg. 1148 and BMC 13.76.110A.
